claims.text: Cover skin erosions with nonadhesive sterile dressings; prevent hypothermia
claims.quote: Nonadhesive sterile dressings should be used to cover areas of skin erosions, and care should be taken to prevent hypothermia, especially in the prehospital setting.
claims.locator: Stevens-Johnson Syndrome and Toxic Epidermal Necrolysis

claims.text: Early ophthalmology consult; eye treatment usually topical lubricants, antibiotic or corticosteroid drops
claims.quote: Early ophthalmology consultation is vital, and treatment usually consists of topical lubricants, antibiotics, or corticosteroid drops.
claims.locator: Stevens-Johnson Syndrome and Toxic Epidermal Necrolysis
